page.overview:
Who is Lizzie?

Lizzie is a main character in Cars, and a supporting character in Cars 2 and Cars 3. She is a black 1923 Ford Model T two-door sedan. She is the owner of her Radiator Springs Curios shop. She sells Route 66 memorabilia and Radiator Springs bumper stickers. She is the wife, now widow, of Stanley, the founder of the town. She is Radiator Springs' most senior resident.

Lizzie's got more gumption than cars half her age. She's been around long enough to see the place rise and fall. Because Lizzie's young at heart, with a mischievous sense of humor, some of the other residents believe she's slightly unhinged. She often takes a nap outside her curio shop on the porch.

Lizzie visits the immortalized Stanley statue outside the fire station every day, remembering the good times they had together.

Lizzie believes in always telling it like it is, no matter what others may think (even if she can't remember exactly what "it" is). Her straight-talking comments often surprise the younger inhabitants of Radiator Springs.
